Valuations and changes to our estimates  We believe NYKAA should continue to deliver healthy growth in Beauty, supported by premiumization, customer additions, and festive demand, while Fashion is showing improving growth and sustained break-even.
watch: Valuations remain a key deterrent, and we await a better risk-reward profile to turn constructive on the stock.

Our view: Improving Fashion margins remain key to earnings growth  Beauty remains the core growth driver, with premiumization supporting growth and margins: Beauty NSV grew 28% YoY, while AOV increased ~5%, which management attributed to premiumization.
